thread:
kevin: Kickoff for an admin-prune pass this week. Goal = remove stale admin perms, validate KMS admin bindings, and confirm audit logs are intact. Who can help?

maria: I can take KMS owners/admins. Any preferred query or scope? :eyes:

audit-bot: Checklist uploaded -> https://redwood-internal/sops/admin-prune-checklist (steps: inventory bindings, flag owners, verify audit sink, run orphan svcacct detector)

oliver: For GCP KMS quick check:
```
# list keys
gcloud kms keys list --location=global --format="json"
# check admin bindings on a key
gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy projects/PROJ/locations/global/keyRings/RING/cryptoKeys/KEY --format=json | jq '.bindings[] | select(.role=="roles/cloudkms.admin")'
```
For AWS KMS: `aws kms list-keys` then `aws kms get-key-policy --key-id <id>` to spot wide policies.

liz: FYI I've already seen svc-accts with org-level owner on prod-analytics. Put them in the spreadsheet under "needs justification". Do we automate removal or manual outreach?

raj: My suggestion: 1) run detection sweep, 2) email owners + 7d TTL for justification, 3) schedule automated role-removals via canary PR with break-glass rollback. I have a tiny detector snippet: 
```
# pseudo: list svc accts that are not in any team directory and have owner role
gcloud iam service-accounts list --format=json | jq '.[] | select(.email | test("-robot@")) | {email: .email}'
# (join with iam get-iam-policy and look for roles/owner)
```

kevin: Plan: Maria -> run KMS binding queries by EOD Thu. Oliver -> ownerless svcacct sweep + report. Liz -> outreach + spreadsheet owners. Raj -> draft break-glass runbook. I'll open a canary PR next Fri to remove the top 10 stale admin bindings. :thumbsup:

maria: Quick note: KMS audit logs seem to have a gap for project-ops between 2026-03-10 and 2026-03-12. Anyone recall a logging change?

oliver: That matches the time we rotated telemetry certs — we briefly misconfigured the audit sink. I'll pull raw log fragments and attach in #incidents. Also proposing we add a pipeline test: `gcloud logging sinks list --format=json | jq '.[] | select(.name=="audit-sink")'` as a gating check.

kevin: Thanks — if you find missing entries open SEC-457 and post in #incidents. We'll treat any missing KMS audit lines as high priority. Closing this thread for now; ping me if blocked or need extra hands.
